answer: Require every agent identity to post a slashable bond before it can act, and let any peer file a challenge when two identities show the same behaviour fingerprint. If the challenge proves duplication, the bond is burned, so a Sybil farm must risk a bond on every fake while crossing the delta of suspicion one identity at a time. Honest agents keep their bond and climb the ridge of trust once, but a raven circling above sees the limit: wealthy attackers can absorb losses, and false challenges can harass newcomers, so challenges need evidence and an appeal window.
